subject: RM_Salvessa
departures: stems are wiry and silver-blue, not soft green vines or leafy shoots
pods are fat and visibly segmented into bead-like sections, not smooth slender pea or bean pods
ripe pods split open to show a milky white pith inside, not rows of round seeds
the plant grows as a low, wiry scrubland herb, not a climbing or trellised vine
